Checklist status for “Solstein Repository Full Audit with OpenClaw” (based on run evidence + PR https://github.com/Ai-Whisperers/solstein/pull/68):
[x] Launch full multi-agent codebase audit
[x] Roast every subsystem in depth
[x] For each issue: explain what’s wrong
[x] For each issue: explain how it should be fixed
[x] Enforce constraint: no implementation
[x] Output strictly analysis, documentation, structured critique
[x] Enforce summary constraint (analysis-only, executive summary + appendix + JSON + severity tiers)
[x] Map full repository architecture (modules, boundaries, dependencies)
[x] Identify architectural anti-patterns and tight coupling
[x] Deep subsystem audit (maturity, abstraction quality, interface clarity)
[x] Detect dead code, zombie branches, speculative scaffolding
[x] Static analysis sweep (lint/type/edge-case findings documented as analysis)
[x] Complexity hotspots (cyclomatic risk areas)
[x] Concurrency / async hazard detection
[x] Basic security posture review (auth/tokens/privilege)
[x] Configuration surface review (hardcoded secrets/env brittleness)

* Still Pending

[ ] Confirm OpenClaw → ACP → OpenCode → MCP → VPS chain stability with no silent failures (not fully met; ACP path had silent failure, fallback succeeded)
[ ] Validate reproducibility of audit results (not yet fully validated in repeated runs - Docker automation must be enforced on Hostinger UI manually first, Im planning to use playwright so the agents configure this in the best possible way)
